title: Section C SC-10: the token symbol (chosen by the token deployer) is put unescaped into Telegram Markdown alerts and the dashboard notification feed

evidence.note: Buy TX sent alert interpolates symbol
parse_mode Markdown; an API error is only logged
the existing sanitizer is not used for symbols

sibling_sites_checked: Every sendCtxAlert in bot.ts that carries token-controlled text checked: symbol at :1023, :1147, :1190, :1341, :1472, :1515; reasons are sanitized (:941, :1282, :323). Addresses are hex and safe. alphaDrop.ts alerts carry only the address. The dashboard rendering side belongs to the DASHBOARD slice.
severity_rationale: S2: a deployer can choose a symbol that breaks Markdown (Telegram rejects the message, sendCtxAlert swallows the error, so the operator loses that alert, for example "Buy TX sent" or "TX failed") or that injects a link or fake text into the operator channel. Capital effect is indirect (lost or forged operator information). sanitizeReason exists but is applied only to reason strings.
recommendation: Escape or sanitize every token-controlled string at the alert boundary (alert text only, no trading behaviour change). Phase 29.
